# Slop factory definition (test fixture)

The engine's test copy of a definition in the layout of ADR-0021, agent-only (#674-#678): `factory.yaml`
(what the factory has), `workflow.yaml` (how it works) and `roles/<role>/role.md`. Tests change copies of it;
`factory/tests/fixtures/slop/` is the regenerated copy of slop-eval-factory itself.
